- **Set reminders:** Use your phone or a calendar app to remind you to take your PrEP daily.

- **Create a routine:** Take your PrEP at the same time every day, like with a meal or before bed.

- **Keep it visible:** Store your PrEP where you see it every day, like next to your toothbrush.

- **Practice mindfulness:** Deep breathing or meditation can help reduce anxiety.

- **Seek support:** Join a support group or speak with others who are also on PrEP.
